si_4_title.answer: Neuroanatomical heterogeneity and homogeneity in individuals at clinical high risk for psychosis

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: The study uses the ENIGMA CHR-P dataset, which pools data from 29 international sites.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "The ENIGMA CHR-P consortium applied a harmonised analysis to neuroimaging data across 29 international sites... offering the largest pooled CHR-P neuroimaging dataset to date."

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: The Healthy Controls (HC) from the ENIGMA CHR-P dataset were used as a normative reference to calculate Person-Based Similarity Index (PBSI) scores for the Clinical High Risk for Psychosis (CHR-P) individuals from the same dataset.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "Normative reference: Next, the respective neuroanatomical profiles of each CHR-P individual were correlated with the corresponding profiles of the members of the HC group"
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: study_1/Baldwin2022.pdf.md: Methods / Person-Based Similarity Index, Paragraph 3

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: The study used 1243 HC participants as the normative reference group for calculating PBSI z-scores for CHR-P individuals. No separate training/test split for the normative model is mentioned; the whole HC group serves as the reference.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: "including 1579 CHR-P individuals and 1243 HC... Normative reference: Next, the respective neuroanatomical profiles of each CHR-P individual were correlated with the corresponding profiles of the members of the HC group"
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.location: study_1/Baldwin2022.pdf.md: ARTICLE OPEN / Methods / Person-Based Similarity Index
